name: Jenny (Eddleston) Homer
headline: Vice President Partnerships EMEA & APAC ANZ at Contentful
position: Vice President, Partnerships EMEA & APAC/ ANZ
about:
With 18+ years of experience driving growth for software and services companies, I specialise in shaping strategic partnerships and building high-value ecosystems in AI, Content Management Software (CMS), and Composable Architecture. I help organisations adopt scalable, flexible solutions to enhance customer engagement and digital experience, enabling them to stay agile in a rapidly evolving market.

I’ve led alliances and partner strategies across both Vendor and Partner (Agency/SI/Reseller) sides, managing high-performing, international teams in fast-growing environments. My expertise spans SaaS, CPaaS, Customer Data Platforms, and AI-driven solutions, with a deep focus on leveraging Composable Architecture and Headless CMS to create future-proof ecosystems.

Specialties:

AI & Machine Learning Integration
Content Management Software & Digital Asset Management
Composable Architecture & Headless CMS
Digital Experience & Omnichannel Engagement
SaaS & CPaaS
Customer Data Platforms & Personalisation
Commerce Platforms, Marketplace Strategy, and Online Payments
Contact Centre, Messaging, and Programmable Voice & Video
Go-to-Market Strategies & Commercial Alliances
Marketing Technology & Marketplace Development

Leadership Values: Energy | Accountability | Authenticity | Balance | Building

I thrive in roles that challenge the status quo, driving organisational transformation, unlocking new revenue streams, and leading teams to surpass ambitious goals. My focus on AI, Content Management, and Composable Architecture helps partners and organisations create scalable, intelligent solutions that meet evolving customer and business demands.

Let’s connect to explore how we can collaborate to drive growth and innovation across the EMEA region!
